tag.description: This is the tag for the token. It represents its scope.

id.description: This is the unique identifier for the token.

orgId.description: This is unique identifier for the org that this token belongs to.

createdAt.description: This is the ISO 8601 date-time string of when the token was created.

updatedAt.description: This is the ISO 8601 date-time string of when the token was last updated.

name.description: This is the name of the token. This is just for your own reference.

restrictions.description: This are the restrictions for the token.
